subject.title: feat(plugins): expose resolved agentId on plugin command context

question: Should OpenClaw support optional `ctx.agentId` as a public `PluginCommandContext` field for plugin command handlers?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but adding a public Plugin SDK field commits OpenClaw to stable availability and semantics for third-party plugins.

options.title: Accept and document `ctx.agentId`
options.body: Approve the optional resolved-agent command context field, require a short SDK docs note, and merge after normal checks stay green.

options.title: Decline the public field
options.body: Close this PR and keep plugin command authors on existing `sessionKey` and runtime helper surfaces for agent/session resolution.

options.title: Defer to broader identity design
options.body: Pause this PR and decide command, register-time, tool, and channel identity fields together with related Plugin SDK identity requests.

recommendation.title: Accept and document `ctx.agentId`
recommendation.body: Approve the optional resolved-agent command context field, require a short SDK docs note, and merge after normal checks stay green.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for broad plugin command and binding surface decisions is the merged plugin-surface work in PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/45318.
